platformNote: The preview shown above is of the Qingo vending app.

steps.title: Tap Card or Scan QR
steps.desc: Customers present their credit/debit card, phone wallet (Apple/Google Pay), or scan the unique QR code on the glass front. The magnetic secure lock releases the door instantly.

steps.title: Grab Desired Items
steps.desc: Open the double-tempered anti-fog glass door and take any combination of beverages, fresh foods, snacks, or salads. Customers can inspect labels and return unwanted items freely.

steps.title: Close Door & Go
steps.desc: Upon door closure, the door locks, physical load-cell shelves measure the exact items removed, and the cloud computer processes the bill seamlessly in under 3 seconds.
